snippet.title: Kynseed Comes to Consoles Aug 4 — Switch, PS4, PS5, XBOX Series X|S & XBOX One
snippet.description:
The much-loved PC life sim RPG Kynseed is coming to consoles on August 4th. Farm, run shops, explore a charming sandbox world, befriend villagers, raise a family, and shape a legacy that lives on across generations.


Wishlist Kynseed on Steam ► https://goo.gl/uQkfwJ

Kynseed is a sandbox RPG adventure life sim from developers behind the Fable series.


————————————
FOLLOW KYNSEED:
————————————
Steam ► https://goo.gl/uQkfwJ
Twitter ► http://Twitter.com/Kynseed
Facebook ► http://Facebook.com/Kynseed
Forums ► https://goo.gl/dJw5Nx
Website ► https://pixelcountstudios.com


————————————
ABOUT KYNSEED:
————————————
Kynseed is a 2D sandbox adventure from veterans of Lionhead Studios’ Fable series. Drawing from years of experience crafting the iconic Fable titles, we aim to deliver an all-new quirky RPG filled to the brim with mystery, exploration, awful puns, and sandbox possibilities.

While invoking the spirit of past Fable games, Kynseed is infused with our own ideas and a mix of British folklore, ancient legend, and rustic traditions. We hope to capture these inspirations in an atmospheric world with whimsy, humour, and eccentricity, and not a single orc or high elf in sight.


————————————
ABOUT PIXELCOUNT STUDIOS:
————————————
PixelCount Studios, creators of Kynseed, is one of the baby Phoenix chicks that has sprung from the ashes of Lionhead Studios. Based in sunny England, our fledgling studio consists of Lionhead veterans who have been involved in EVERY Fable game, Black & White, and The Movies (among others).

PixelCount’s current project is Kynseed, a 2D sandbox RPG full of quirk and charm. While invoking the spirit of past Fable games, Kynseed is infused with our own ideas and a mix of British folklore, ancient legend, and rustic traditions.

Our goal as a studio is to continue the spirit of Lionhead with games that are charming, humorous, very British, and eccentric. We’re not interested in fleecing you with DLC, withholding cool stuff, or being overly secretive about what we’re doing. We love one thing: games. And you. So…two things. Games, you, and biscuits. Three! Three things!
